import hashlib, importlib.util, json
from pathlib import Path
from arcpuzzles.parametric_worker import _real_evaluator, _grid
p=Path('generators/7fe59337a0b4/workspace/parametric')
def load(name):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('self_review_'+name,p/(name+'.py'))
    m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m); return m
f=load('native_family'); a=load('adapter')
source={str(path):hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in sorted(p.glob('*')) if path.suffix in ('.py','.rkt','.json')}
rotation='(r1 (rotate-cw r0)) (r2 (rotate-cw r1)) (r3 (rotate-cw r2))'
reverse=f.CANONICAL_BODY.replace(rotation, '(r1 (rotate-cw (rotate-cw (rotate-cw r0)))) (r2 (rotate-cw (rotate-cw r0))) (r3 (rotate-cw r0))')
points='(filter (lambda (p) (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p)))) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 9))))) (grid-positions g))'
gate=f'(let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells {points})) (mr (first (first (find-color g 9))))) (if (> (first bb) mr) {reverse} {f.CANONICAL_BODY}))'
result={'schema':'arcpuzzles-private-self-review-finding-v1','task_id':'7fe59337a0b4','seed':17,'source_sha256':source,'rival':'reverse_turns_for_source_below_marker','description':'Use the clockwise orbit except for an original motif wholly below the marker, where turn order is reversed; apply the episode link setting afterwards.','scope':'Two declared settings at seed 17, 3 demos and 4 queries; source-bound finite counterexample, no owner acceptance.','episodes':[]}
execute, identity, bridge=_real_evaluator(Path('shared/runtime'))
result['racket']=identity
try:
    for setting in ({'links':'none'},{'links':'first_hit'}):
        episode=a.generate(17,setting,demos=3,queries=4)
        program=f.program(setting)
        rival=f'(rule! (lambda (g) {gate}))' if setting['links']=='none' else f.linked_program(body=gate)
        predictions={split:[] for split in ('train','test')}
        for split in ('train','test'):
            for pair in episode[split]:
                actual=_grid(execute(program,pair['input']))
                assert actual==pair['output'],'intended label mismatch'
                predictions[split].append(_grid(execute(rival,pair['input'])))
        fits=all(prediction==pair['output'] for prediction,pair in zip(predictions['train'],episode['train']))
        conflicts=[i for i,(prediction,pair) in enumerate(zip(predictions['test'],episode['test'])) if prediction!=pair['output']]
        result['episodes'].append({'settings':setting,'episode':episode,'rival_program':rival,'rival_predictions':predictions,'fits_every_demo':fits,'query_conflicts':conflicts})
        assert fits and conflicts, 'finding did not reproduce'
finally:
    bridge.close()
result['status']='confirmed_teaching_gap'
dest=Path('../checks/7fe59337a0b4/self-review-below-source-v1.json');dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
dest.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'path':str(dest),'status':result['status'],'racket':identity,'episodes':[{'settings':row['settings'],'fits_every_demo':row['fits_every_demo'],'query_conflicts':row['query_conflicts']} for row in result['episodes']]}))
